pool.b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage: Good day, coach, this is the agency of {name}. It is about the expiring contract.
Good day, coach, I am calling for {name}. We need to talk about the extension.
pool.b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage.hi: My client {name} is tired of being kept waiting, and he rants in my ear every evening.
Coach, {name} is fuming, and I am supposed to settle the contract at last.
pool.b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage.lo: {name} feels attached to the club and asked me to settle the extension calmly and fairly.
Good day, coach. {name} wants to stay and told me not to rush anything.
pool.b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage.eh: {name} wants to know where the club is heading sportingly before he signs anything.
My client {name} thinks in trophies, not in months. That shapes the extension as well.
pool.b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage.we: {name} has enquiries on the table, and I must tell him what is possible here.
Good day, coach, my client {name} is looking around, that is part of the business.
pool.b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage.se: {name} longs for appreciation, and the contract weighs on him more than he shows.
Coach, my client {name} takes the extension more personally than one would think.
pool.b.verhandlung_gehalt_lage: Coach, this is the agency of {name} on the line. We need to talk about money.
This is {name}'s agent speaking. It is about the level of the salary.
pool.b.verhandlung_gehalt_lage.hitzig: {name} fumes when he looks at his payslip, and I am supposed to iron it out.
Coach, my client is up in arms over his pay, and I understand him.
pool.b.verhandlung_gehalt_lage.loyal: {name} dislikes talking about money, so I do it for him, and politely.
My client loves this club, and that is exactly why he wishes for fair pay.
pool.b.verhandlung_gehalt_lage.ehrgeizig: {name} measures himself against the best, also in pay, and that is not vanity but ambition.
My client sees himself in the front row and wants the payslip to show it.
pool.b.verhandlung_gehalt_lage.wechselfr: {name} knows his market value, and he knows other clubs would pay more.
My client has seen offers that are clearly higher. That belongs in this conversation.
pool.b.verhandlung_gehalt_lage.sensibel: {name} feels undervalued in his pay and struggles to say so.
My client is hurt when he compares his pay with that of colleagues.
pool.b.verhandlung_rolle_lage: Good day, coach, I am calling about the role of {name} in the squad. It belongs in the contract.
This is {name}'s agency. It is about his place in the team.
pool.b.verhandlung_rolle_lage.hitzig: {name} is fed up with stewing on the bench, and I am supposed to get it in writing.
Coach, my client is raging about his playing time, and I want something in hand.
pool.b.verhandlung_rolle_lage.loyal: {name} trusts you but asked me to put his place in the contract more clearly.
My client likes to stay but wants to know where he stands sportingly, and that should be settled calmly.
pool.b.verhandlung_rolle_lage.ehrgeizig: {name} wants to be a regular, not a reserve, and for that I demand a word from you.
My client wants to be needed. A role in the background is out of the question for him.
pool.b.verhandlung_rolle_lage.wechselfre: {name} has a first-team guarantee on the table elsewhere. Here I must show something similar.
My client can choose his role anywhere, and I want to know what you offer him.
pool.b.verhandlung_rolle_lage.sensibel: {name} suffers from the uncertainty about his place, and it gnaws at his confidence.
My client needs clarity about where he belongs, otherwise he loses heart.
pool.b.verhandlung_klausel_lage: Good day, coach, this is the agency of {name}. It is about a release clause in the contract.
I am calling for {name}. My client wishes for a clause for the worst case.
pool.b.verhandlung_klausel_lage.hitzig: {name} will not be locked in, and without a clause you will not get him to the desk.
Coach, my client insists on a way out, and he tolerates no excuses.
pool.b.verhandlung_klausel_lage.loyal: {name} would never want to leave the club, but out of caution he wants a clause secured.
My client stays out of conviction. The clause would only be a safety net, nothing more.
pool.b.verhandlung_klausel_lage.ehrgeizi: {name} wants to keep the door to a top club open. For that he needs a fixed fee in the contract.
My client thinks of the next step, and the clause is the key to it.
pool.b.verhandlung_klausel_lage.wechself: {name} lets nothing be blocked. A clause belongs in every contract he considers.
My client wants to be able to leave any time when something better comes.
pool.b.verhandlung_klausel_lage.sensibel: {name} needs the feeling of not being trapped, and a clause would give him peace.
My client fears being stuck at the club and wants to know there is a way out.
